backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual shares_diluted facts are known by SEC filed date (<= signal date) and compared against the prior comparable annual period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts filed date, period end, and duration_days

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Companyfacts diluted-share-count contraction paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation may identify capital-return and anti-dilution leadership candidates without adding noisy tickers.
interpretation: The diluted-share-count contraction source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed share-count contraction bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT shareholder-yield evidence such as explicit completion/progress fields, free cash flow coverage of buybacks, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep share-count contraction thresholds, fact age, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose latest filed annual diluted share count is 1%-25% lower than the prior comparable annual period may have real capital-return / anti-dilution support, and should be better candidates when liquid SPY-relative price confirmation is also present.

2_history_check.exp-20260514-010: Rejected SEC buyback credibility text overlay. This run does not use disclosure language; it uses filed-date Companyfacts share count outcomes.
2_history_check.exp-20260520-039: Rejected remaining repurchase capacity text. This run avoids authorization wording and measures actual diluted-share-count contraction.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-017: Accepted Companyfacts low-liability + RS support. That accepted field never tests share-count contraction.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-020/025: Cash-conversion/accruals quality used net_income, operating_cash_flow, and assets; this run uses a distinct shareholder-yield proxy and does not retune those failed bundles.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Companyfacts exposes filed-date shares_diluted across all fixed windows and this field is distinct from rejected buyback text and cash-flow accruals; the risk is that share-count contraction is stale or just reselects existing mega-cap momentum.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual shares_diluted current/prior facts, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual diluted-share-count contraction gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

rejection_reason: window_ev_regression; window_pnl_regression; fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows; drawdown_drift_too_high; accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten; accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten
